def build_agent(sandbox):
    foundation = sandbox.get_foundation()
    
    # Base beam with reduced width (8.5m) to create buffer within ±4.5m foundation zone
    base_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x=0, y=0, width=8.5, height=1.0, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(foundation, base_beam, anchor=(0, 0), type='rigid')
    # Add spring between foundation and base beam for seismic damping
    sandbox.add_spring(foundation, base_beam, anchor_a=(0, 0), anchor_b=(0, 0), stiffness=15.0, damping=0.8)
    
    # First vertical beam (from base to y=10m)
    vertical_beam_1 = sandbox.add_beam(x=0, y=5.25, width=0.5, height=9.5, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(base_beam, vertical_beam_1, anchor=(0, 0.5), type='rigid')
    
    # First horizontal beam at y=10m (width matches base beam for symmetry)
    horizontal_beam_1 = sandbox.add_beam(x=0, y=10.25, width=8.5, height=0.5, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(vertical_beam_1, horizontal_beam_1, anchor=(0, 10), type='rigid')
    # Add spring between base and first horizontal beam for vibration damping
    sandbox.add_spring(base_beam, horizontal_beam_1, anchor_a=(0, 0.5), anchor_b=(0, 10), stiffness=10.0, damping=0.7)
    
    # Second vertical beam (from horizontal_beam_1 to y=20m)
    vertical_beam_2 = sandbox.add_beam(x=0, y=15.25, width=0.5, height=9.5, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(horizontal_beam_1, vertical_beam_2, anchor=(0, 10.5), type='rigid')
    
    # Second horizontal beam at y=20m (width matches base beam)

    sandbox.add_joint(vertical_beam_2, horizontal_beam_2, anchor=(0, 20), type='rigid')
    # Add spring between horizontal levels for additional damping
    sandbox.add_spring(horizontal_beam_1, horizontal_beam_2, anchor_a=(0, 10), anchor_b=(0, 20), stiffness=10.0, damping=0.7)
    
    # Third vertical beam (from horizontal_beam_2 to y=30m)
    vertical_beam_3 = sandbox.add_beam(x=0, y=25.25, width=0.5, height=9.5, density=1.0)
    sandbox.add_joint(horizontal_beam_2, vertical_beam_3, anchor=(0, 20.5), type='rigid')

    sandbox.add_joint(vertical_beam_3, horizontal_beam_3, anchor=(0, 30), type='rigid')
    # Add spring between upper levels for vibration control
    sandbox.add_spring(horizontal_beam_2, horizontal_beam_3, anchor_a=(0, 20), anchor_b=(0, 30), stiffness=10.0, damping=0.7)
